title: Water from the Rock
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who pauses and ponders before she moves, and tonight is about a people who rushed ahead instead of listening: the Lord says their peace could have been like a river, and Wren stands still at the corner, asks one more time, and then walks the way her grandpa said.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she stops and listens before she moves. In Wren’s world today: her big sister says the shortcut goes left, but her grandpa said right. Wren stands still at the corner in her coral red boots and thinks about it. She waits, asks one more time, then takes the way grandpa said. Just like the people who were told to listen so their peace could be like a river, Wren learned that listening comes before walking.
